        i = 0

        while i < n:

            while j < n and s[j] == s[i]:
                j += 1
            runs.append((s[i], j - i))
            i = j

        for k in range(1, len(runs) - 1):

                    and runs[k + 1][0] == '0'):
                best_gain = max(best_gain, runs[k - 1][1] + runs[k + 1][1])
